name.jp: ステラ・ヴァーミリオン

titles: 法米利昂皇国第二皇女
破军学园一年级A级伐刀者

status.current: qualifies for the Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival and accepts Ikki's proposal to become his family

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Lover; she struggles with desire and public scrutiny but refuses to abandon their bond, wins her own match in seconds, and rushes to encourage him.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Rival for Ikki's affection and gradually trusted ally; Shizuku attacks her to snap her out of despair.
relationships.toka-todo: Receives care from Toka during the Okutama incident and learns from Toka's balanced sword-and-ability style.
relationships.vermillion-king: Father whose approval becomes politically crucial; Stella fears his overprotectiveness but wants to introduce Ikki proudly.

periods.summary: Stella watches Shizuku's match, supports her rival from the stands, and later secretly continues her romance with Ikki. During the Okutama investigation she catches a severe summer cold, is cared for by Ikki in a mountain hut, and discusses intimacy, marriage order, and meeting each other's parents. The leaked kiss photo turns her relationship into a manufactured scandal; she briefly blames herself and considers separation, but Shizuku violently reminds her that Ikki is defending their love. Stella then resolves to fight in her own way: she wins her final selection battle in three seconds, arrives in time to encourage Ikki, and after his victory accepts his proposal. When Akaza tries to interfere, she casually knocks him away while carrying Ikki to treatment.

key_events.summary: Falls ill during the mountain search and discusses future family meetings with Ikki.
Is shaken by the scandal until Shizuku forces her to face Ikki's resolve.
Wins her final match immediately and brings her representative medal to Ikki.
Accepts Ikki's request that she become his family.

abilities: learns the principle of Nuk足/Ash-walking well enough to use it on Akaza
